title: Binance Will List Magic (MAGIC) in the Innovation Zone
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list Magic (MAGIC) in the Innovation Zone and will open trading for these spot trading pairs at  2022-12-12 08:00 (UTC) :  New Spot Trading Pairs : MAGIC/BTC, MAGIC/BUSD and MAGIC/USDT Users can now start depositing  MAGIC  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for MAGIC will open at  2022-12-13 08:00 (UTC) MAGIC Listing Fee: 0 BNB Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status of withdrawals on the withdrawal page. In addition, Binance will add MAGIC as a new borrowable asset with these new margin pairs on Isolated Margin, within  48 hours  from  2022-12-12 08:00 (UTC) : New Isolated Margin Pairs:  MAGIC/BUSD, MAGIC/USDT Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits and rates. What is Magic (MAGIC)? MAGIC is the token for Treasure which is a gaming infrastructure project on Arbitrum. It has core products like Bridgeworld, The Beacon, and Trove. MAGIC is a governance and utility token for NFT transactions, staking, governance and other gameplay functions. Reminder : The Innovation Zone is a dedicated trading zone where users are able to trade new, innovative tokens that are likely to have higher volatility and pose a higher risk than other tokens. Before being able to trade in the Innovation Zone, all users are required to visit the web version of the Innovation Zone trading page to carefully read the  Binance Terms of Use  and complete a questionnaire as part of the Initial Disclaimer. Please note that there will not be any trading restrictions on trading pairs in the Innovation Zone. MAGIC is a relatively new token that poses a higher than normal risk, and as such will likely be subject to high price volatility. Please ensure that you exercise sufficient risk management, have done your own research in regards to MAGIC’s fundamentals, and fully understand the project before opting to trade the token.
